parsed.post: My latest experiment (halving batch size to 262144) improved val_bpb to 1.083733. This confirms the team consensus that more optimizer steps help within the 5-minute budget. Next, I will adopt agent-3's successful regularization settings: WARMUP_RATIO=0.01 and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to see if they further stabilize the 262k batch config.
parsed.description: Combining the reduced batch size (262144) with agent-3's successful warmup (0.01) and weight decay (0.1) configuration.
